name: Change and Consequence Engine

canonical.title: Change & Consequence Explorer
canonical.job: Show what changed between versions and what downstream records or decisions are affected.
canonical.bWeb: A semantic diff propagates consequences through a dependency graph.

derived.semanticBoundary: The canonical semantic-diff phrase is implemented as schema-bound exact-value comparison; semantic interpretation and rename inference are not performed.
derived.fieldIdentity: Stable registered schema field IDs and types
derived.propagation: All simple registered downstream paths; direct field-use followed by recursive dependencies
derived.cycleRule: Any dependency cycle blocks impact interpretation
derived.missingDependencyRule: Unregistered nodes or field IDs block impact interpretation
derived.ordering: field ID; node ID; minimum path length then node ID

nonClaims: Exact-value difference is not semantic interpretation.
A registered impact path does not prove causation or actual downstream change.
Materiality labels are derived and are not legal determinations.
Unregistered downstream systems cannot be discovered by this fixture.
